headline: Washington looks to stay perfect against struggling Arizona State squad
subhead: The fourth-ranked Huskies visit Tempe seeking their third straight win while Arizona State searches for answers after consecutive losses.

xFactor.why: Arizona State's defense must force Washington into mistakes early to avoid falling into a two-score hole they cannot climb out of given their offensive struggles.

keyMatchup: Washington's offensive line execution against Arizona State's front seven will determine whether the Huskies can establish the ground game and control clock in a hostile environment.
body: Washington arrives in Tempe riding genuine momentum after a five-point road win over Miami that required late-game composure. The Huskies have shown they can win tight contests and execute when pressure peaks, which matters against an Arizona State team desperate for any sign of competence after dropping consecutive games by narrow margins.

Arizona State's 0-2 start masks a team that has played closer than its record suggests, falling short by three to LSU in Week Two. The home crowd will provide energy the Sun Devils have lacked on the road, but Washington's poise and ranking reflect a program that has answered every challenge so far this season. Arizona State's window to build momentum closes quickly if they cannot find answers on both lines of scrimmage.
